name: netsurit-video
description: Make Netsurit-branded animated explainer videos in the technique proven on The Enterprise Brain: soft geometric illustration in the Netsurit CI (netsurit-soft; the infographic look is still available), ElevenLabs narration timed to the words, optional Eleven Music, shape-morph and diagonal-wipe chapters and the Netsurit end card, rendered for WhatsApp (9:16) and 16:9 with measured review checks. Includes prerequisite checks and setup guidance. By Louis de Klerk.
